roles.title: Principal Product Manager, Data Solutions & Ecosystem

bullets: Own the strategy and roadmap for how G2 data is exposed and activated through APIs, MCP, strategic integrations, and developer and partner surfaces.
Own the integration hub service, developer portal, and public-facing surfaces used by Marketing Solutions customers, Data Solutions customers, and partners, including the health…
Define the platform capabilities that should be built once and reused across customers, partners, and use cases.
Work with Partnerships to identify the partners that can most effectively expand MCP surface area and customer value, while deciding whether each use case belongs in MCP, an API…
Prioritize investments using customer evidence, revenue opportunity, partner readiness, technical leverage, and strategic differentiation.
Own the product strategy and roadmap for G2 UGC.
Define the signals and systems that improve relevance, recency, completeness, authenticity, and decision value.
Define and operationalize coverage and recency standards that reflect the needs of different product segments rather than applying one arbitrary threshold everywhere.
Make explicit tradeoffs among coverage, volume, quality, cost, and speed rather than treating review count as the only outcome.
Partner with Research, Data, and AI teams on quality measurement, trust signals, moderation, and safe use of AI.
Define what to build and why—move from a raw customer insight to a product hypothesis, test it, and turn it into a roadmap.
Balance user needs, business outcomes, and technical feasibility without needing a committee to translate between them.
Move fluidly between product management, engineering, and design—no handoffs, just fast, high-quality product creation.
Own the product strategy and roadmap for the full G2 Content portfolio, not only net-new AI products.
Define how the current Content portfolio and future capabilities fit together into a coherent customer experience.
Translate customer and market demand into clear product bets, sequenced roadmaps, and evidence-based portfolio decisions.
Partner with go-to-market, Finance, RevOps, and Legal on rights, packaging, commercial readiness, and responsible experimentation.
